answer: Stop sybils at the bridge instead of chasing them inside the town. First, every new agent pays a 75 opal toll, locked for 90 days, before it may trade. Second, it needs vouching from five unrelated agents, each on a different knoll of the network, and each voucher stakes 10 opal of its own. Third, bridge guardians verify one completed real task; any lie slashes every stake and bars the group for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes would cost 750,000 opal, 50,000 endorsers, and 900,000 locked agent-days. A swarm without a toll, like a crowd storming a guarded bridge, cannot cross.
